mapper.select: select count(*) from SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO where STATUS in ('0','1')

select t.seq_no seqNo, t.model_code modelCode, t.status status, to_char(t.busi_date,'yyyy-mm-dd') busiDate, to_char(t.start_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') startTime, to_char(t.end_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') endTime, CASE WHEN status in ('2', '3') THEN round(extract(second from (t.end_time - t.start_time)),2) else 0 END useingTime from SYS_UNACCOUNTANT_INFO_DETAIL t where t.seq_no=#{seqNo}

select
A.SYSTEM_CODE systemCode, A.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO batchExedetailSeqNo, A.BEAN_NAME beanName,
CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS in ('EXP', 'END') THEN A.UPDATE_TIME ELSE null END as batchEndTime, CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS in ('EXP', 'END') THEN round(extract(second from (A.UPDATE_TIME - A.CREATE_TIME)),2) else 0 END useingTime, A.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, A.UPDATE_USER updateUser, A.TASK_ID as taskId, A.SEQ_NO, A.EXECUTE_DATE as batchDate, A.CREATE_TIME batchStartTime, A.TASK_STATUS as taskStatus, A.TASK_STATUS as taskStatusCode, A.START_MODE as startMode, A.CREATE_USER as createUser， B.TASK_NAME as taskName FROM SYS_BATCH_EXEC_INFO A, SYS_BATCH_TASK B WHERE A.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO IN ( SELECT SEQ_NO FROM SYS_BATCHGRP_EXEC_INFO D WHERE D.OTHER_PARAM3 =#{execTaskIdBatch} ) and a.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO!=#{execTaskIdBatch} and B.task_id=A.task_id
and A.TASK_STATUS =#{taskStatus}
